设计意图： Mutation from parent's simple rolling mean to exponential weighted moving average. EWMA places higher weight on recent volume observations, improving responsiveness to changes in trading activity while preserving the core economic mechanism of sustained relative volume smoothing. This targets the parent's low IC and RankIC by making the signal more timely without adding new features or increasing

📐 因子表达式 DSL (FactorEngine)

-(EWMA of <vol_ratio>(volume/EMA) over span 20)
已转 FactorEngine（真实 DSL，parse_expr 验证通过）

🧮 计算步骤（通俗版，已合并重复/中间变量）

  1. 1. ts_ema —— 指数移动平均
    ts_ema(divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20)), 20)
  2. 2. divide —— 除法(自动防除零)
    divide(Volume, ts_mean(Volume, 20))
  3. 3. ts_mean —— 过去 N 天滚动平均
    ts_mean(Volume, 20)
